title: Fix Deployment compensation outbox-to-owner HTTP 422 contract error
summary: Source-only repair of the Deployment compensation outbox-to-owner HTTP 422 contract error. In services/deployment/outbox_consumer_worker.py, removed unverified lineage_ref from _incident_payload so incident creation conforms to CanonicalReferenceValidator (BP5-SVC-011) when runtime binding telemetry projections are not yet materialized during deployment-stage failures. Handled RuntimeManagerClientError during rollback execution to fail closed cleanly into safe-mode pause and incident containment, and enabled forwarding of human_gate_decision for governance-compliant rollbacks. Verified with 81 passing tests in test_outbox_consumer_worker.py and full passing suites in test_deployment_saga.py, test_service.py, and test_runtime_manager.py.

incident_context.failure_trigger: Persona first-evaluation cron.list timed out during provisioning schedule registration

root_cause_analysis.lineage_ref_schema_mismatch: In outbox_consumer_worker.py line 2452, _incident_payload included 'lineage_ref': f"{binding.get('artifact_id')}@{binding.get('artifact_version')}". When _contain_and_raise_incident sent POST /api/incidents, services/incidents/main.py executed CanonicalReferenceValidator.validate_incident(inc). Because lineage_ref was present, CanonicalReferenceValidator attempted to resolve the runtime binding lineage projection via telemetry_lookup.runtime_binding_projection(incident.binding_id). For newly provisioned bindings failing during schedule registration, no telemetry lineage projection exists in the telemetry corpus. CanonicalReferenceValidator raised CanonicalReferenceError: lineage_ref cannot be verified because no runtime binding lineage projection is available, resulting in HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity. The outbox consumer classified 422 as non-retryable and dead-lettered event 0004 to DLQ on attempt 1, stranding the saga in compensating.
root_cause_analysis.rollback_fail_closed_contract: In commit 607e2089c (ROLLBACK-HUMAN-GATE-20260831), runtime-manager was updated to require human_gate_decision for /api/rollback. Rollback attempts without a valid human_gate_decision or encountering precondition failures raise RuntimeManagerClientError (HTTP 400/422). If unhandled, this could crash or leave the outbox worker in an ambiguous state instead of safely executing safe-mode pause containment.

services/deployment/outbox_consumer_work: Removed lineage_ref from _incident_payload: Lineage pointers are optional on CreateIncidentRequest and must only be supplied when verified telemetry lineage projections exist. Omitting lineage_ref allows CanonicalReferenceValidator to pass while strictly validating binding_id, pool_id, plan_id, and artifact metadata against runtime-manager.

Imported RuntimeManagerClientError and wrapped client.rollback() in try...except (RuntimeManagerClientError, RuntimeError): If rollback fails due to missing human_gate_decision or precondition rejections, the worker catches the error and fails closed via _contain_and_raise_incident, ensuring safe-mode pause and durable incident creation.
Forwarded human_gate_decision from rollback config / plan metadata when present, allowing authorized human gate decisions to be propagated to runtime-manager.
services/deployment/test_outbox_consumer: Added test_rollback_compensation_zero_prior_candidates_contains_and_creates_incident verifying containment and incident creation without lineage_ref when no prior candidate exists.
Added test_rollback_execution_error_fails_closed_to_incident_containment verifying fail-closed containment upon RuntimeManagerClientError.
Added test_rollback_propagates_human_gate_decision_when_present verifying human gate decision propagation.

reproduce_actual_422_request_schema.details: Verified against CanonicalReferenceValidator in services/incidents/main.py. Confirmed providing unverified lineage_ref without runtime binding telemetry projection triggers HTTP 422. Omitting lineage_ref preserves authorization and passes reference validation.

no_fabricated_ack_or_blind_dlq_replay.details: No fabricated owner ACK states, no fake approval receipts, and no blind DLQ replay. Event-driven compensation is repaired at the consumer contract layer to execute containment and saga finalization.

preserve_tenant_paper_live_fences_and_si.details: Preserved tenant paper/live fences, idempotency keys, and authoritative side-effect readbacks against runtime-manager get_safe_mode and get_active_for_pool.

verify_valid_compensation_and_fail_close.details: Valid compensation transitions to durable terminal status (failed or retired), while invalid, ambiguous, or unapproved rollback requests fail closed into safe-mode pause containment with durable incident creation.

source_tests_and_exact_head_review.details: All unit tests and adjacent regression suites pass with 0 failures: test_outbox_consumer_worker.py (81 passed), test_deployment_saga.py (9 passed), test_service.py (27 passed), and test_runtime_manager.py (89 passed).
